thread:
sre-bot: Pager alert: HIGH - runtime container crashloop on cluster-gamma (node-gamma-12). Multiple restarts detected in last 5m. Reason: SIGSEGV in fused kernel. Auto-pager triggered to #incidents and oncall.

oncall-jordan: ack. I'm looking. Paging dev-ryan and eng-runtime-lead. @dev-ryan could you please grab logs?

dev-ryan: on it. pulling pod logs now: `kubectl -n inference logs runtime-abc-0 --previous`

dev-ryan: logs show repeated SIGSEGV in fused_kernel.so

dev-ryan: snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T12:23:11Z] runtime: SIGSEGV on address 0x7f4d2a3b
#0  0x7f4d2a3b in fused_kernel::quant_matmul(...)
#1  0x7f4d2b4c in runtime::execute(...)
```

eng-runtime-lead: that looks like the new quantized kernel we rolled out in canary at 11:40. Any canaries in prod?

ops-lex: yes, canary label `q-hp-2026-03-15` was pushed to subset of pods in cluster-gamma.

oncall-jordan: immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale down canary to 0 replicas, 2) rollback image for runtime deployment to previous sha, 3) cordon & drain node-gamma-12 if pods still crash.

maria: I'll run the rollback: `kubectl -n inference set image deployment/runtime runtime=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:sha_abc123` then `kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime`

maria: doing now.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-37. Severity: Sev2. Pager: oncall-jordan.

customer-success-anna: FYI, we're seeing 503s for tenants A12 and B7 in EU region. Customers raised support tickets.

oncall-jordan: noted. tagging customers: A12,B7. @customer-success-anna can you send a short status note once we have rollback confirmed?

ops-lex: rollback completed, pods are restarting. `kubectl get pods -n inference` shows runtime-abc-0 now Running.

dev-ryan: I'm seeing crashloop count dropping. So far replicas stabilizing. Need to confirm root cause before re-deploying q-kernel.

eng-runtime-lead: initial hypothesis: quantization changes introduced an unchecked pointer in fused_kernel leading to OOB read -> SIGSEGV under certain tensor layouts. Repro steps in staging underway.

dev-ryan: repro in staging with same input sequence and batch shape: hit segfault in fused_kernel when sequence_len > 2048 and batch_size 4.

marta-bot: /pageresponders: @eng-runtime-lead to take lead for on-call handoff in 30m if incident persists.

oncall-jordan: handing off active incident to eng-runtime-lead at 12:58 UTC. I'll continue monitoring for 15m then drop ear.

eng-runtime-lead: taking over. I'll start a hotfix branch to add bounds check and push a non-quantized fallback for kernels that match the failing signature.

eng-runtime-lead: proposed short-term fix: build runtime image with fallback flag `--disable-fused-quant` and push as ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:hotfix-0315. Then canary to limited pods for 10m.

ops-lex: prepared the hotfix image and created rollout plan. I'll canary to 2 pods in cluster-gamma.

dev-ryan: good. Also capturing core dumps: `kubectl cp runtime-abc-0:/core /tmp/core-runtime-abc` and starting gdb to get backtrace.

dev-ryan: gdb bt:
```
#0  0x00007f4d2a3b in fused_kernel::quant_matmul at fused_kernel.cc:412
#1  0x00007f4d2b4c in runtime::execute at runtime.cc:1023
```

customer-success-anna: sent customer note: "We're investigating elevated error rates in inference for a subset of EU customers. We're rolling back a recent kernel change and expect services to recover shortly. We'll update in 30 minutes." :thumbsup:

eng-runtime-lead: hotfix canary started. Monitoring latency/error budget.

sre-bot: Update: error rate on cluster-gamma dropped from 9.6% to 0.8% after rollback and hotfix canary.

oncall-jordan: thanks team. I'll mark as stable after one hour of no regression and hand back to normal ops. Please file postmortem with timeline & RCA and include the canary gating checklist failure.

eng-runtime-lead: will own postmortem. Action items: 1) revert quant kernel from auto-rollout, 2) add inputs cover in regression tests, 3) add stricter canary checks for sequence length shapes.

customer-success-anna: customers confirmed recovery. Closing tickets if no further errors in 1h.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-37 status: mitigated. Transitioning to post-incident review."
